### GoalCommandInput

```ts
const GoalCommandInput: Union<
  readonly [
    Struct<{
      action: Literal<"set">;
      objective: String;
      requestId: String;
      expectedRevision: optional<NullOr<String>>;
      confirmed: optional<Boolean>;
    }>,
    Struct<{
      action: Literals<readonly ["pause", "resume", "replace", "clear"]>;
    }>,
    Struct<{}>,
  ]
>;
```

Arguments of the human `/goal` command. A bare call opens the controls; each
reply is a catalog step, so the conversation stays on the server.
